why_high_value: Excellent VDS fit with explicit freelance compatibility, Spain-wide remote option, WordPress/HTML/CSS core and agency-production context.

inferences: The offer text also mentions indefinite employment benefits; the freelance commercial terms are not detailed and should not be inferred.
safe_alternative_angles: Manual application through the official form as a freelance/remote candidate resident in Spain, emphasizing WordPress, frontend, performance and agency production.
